caller_asset_contract.notes: Every checkpoint, accent embedding, tokenizer, text-input manifest, config, licence, runtime lock, target-accent reference and consent record must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 before a caller may process text or audio. No upstream revision is pinned because the merged evidence records only a repository URL. The scope is accent-controlled TTS, never audio-to-audio conversion.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the GenAID source checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision under research/accent-conversion-20261101/repos or data/checkouts; no checkout exists in the workspace.
Resolve https://github.com/jzmzhong/GenAID/ to a full 40-hex commit and publish its per-file SHA-256 manifest; the merged evidence records only the repository URL.
Supply the exact inference checkpoints with byte counts and SHA-256 values at one immutable revision; no weight was downloaded or identified by digest in the merged evidence.

Supply the accent label set, accent embedding table and target accent condition definition with digests; GenAID is accent-controlled TTS, so the target accent condition is a required asset rather than an audio-to-audio transform.

Supply every text normalizer, grapheme/phoneme tokenizer, lexicon and text-frontend configuration declared by the resolved upstream revision, with byte counts and SHA-256 values; none is identified in the merged evidence or present in the workspace.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock at data/envs/genaid/requirements.lock and a recorded platform; no environment, package pin or lock exists.
Add the upstream artifact licence and terms at the resolved commit; no licence file, terms statement or redistribution grant is recorded in the merged evidence or present in the workspace.
Clear weights, training-data, accent-label, text-input, speaker-reference, consent, output-use and redistribution rights with complete notices; no rights or consent record exists.

Freeze a rights-cleared voice cohort with permitted text inputs and target-accent references, language/speaker groups, separate text, identity and naturalness outcomes, and an approved exact-runtime parity vector; no GenAID cohort or parity vector exists.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex source revision, checkpoint, accent embedding and tokenizer SHA-256 values, and the source licence match exact pins.
An isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock is admitted on a recorded platform.
Source, weight, training-data, accent-label, text-input, speaker-reference, consent, output-use and redistribution rights are cleared with complete notices.
An approved exact-runtime GenAID output matches the reference on a frozen caller-supplied text input for one frozen configuration.
A rights-cleared held-out cohort scores text/semantic preservation, identity/similarity and naturalness as separate outcomes.
The synthesis scope, accent condition, output sample rate and channel geometry are established and do not misrepresent an audio-to-audio converter.
Explicit opt-in provider intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

licensing.source_asset_license: unverified; no source checkout, licence file or terms statement is present or recorded

qualification.reason: The GenAID source checkout, full upstream revision, inference weights, accent-condition assets, text frontend/tokenizer and hash-pinned runtime are absent; no licence, rights or consent record, rights-cleared voice cohort or approved parity vector exists, and the candidate is accent-controlled TTS rather than the task's audio-to-audio conversion geometry.

reproduction.comparison: canonical JSON bytes, SHA-256 sidecar and source manifest only; no tolerance

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the voice acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then reproduce the exact model/runtime as a caller-supplied-asset reference and add an opt-in SDK adapter once its prerequisites pass. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails.
stable_fields.title: GenAID
write_scope: SDK provider, tool or evidence directory for genaid and its own fixtures

voice_profile_requirements.requirement: Freeze permitted text inputs and target-accent references with rights and consent.
Freeze task, language and speaker groups for the cohort.
Preserve text and semantic content as its own outcome.
Measure identity or similarity to the target as a separate outcome.
Measure naturalness as a separate outcome.
Record alignment, first-output and tail timing for the exact runtime.
Treat consent, reference availability and output use as independent gates.
